n, m, P = map(int, input().split())

MAXN = 510
C = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
f1 = [0] * MAXN
f2 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
g1 = [0] * MAXN
g2 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]

for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % P

f1[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    f1[i] = 0
    g1[i] = 0
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1[i] = (f1[i] + f1[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        t = ((f1[j - 1] * g1[i - j] + g1[j - 1] * f1[i - j]) % P)
        t = (t * (i + 1)) % P
        g1[i] = (g1[i] + (f1[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % P * (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) + t) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P

    f1[i] = (i + 1) * f1[i] % P

g2[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
        f2[i][j] = f2[i - 1][j]
        g2[i][j] = g2[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            f_val = f2[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            f2[i][j] = (f2[i][j] + f_val * f1[k] % P * C[j][k]) % P
            g_val = f2[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            g_part = (g_val * g1[k] + (g2[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 0) * f1[k]) % P
            g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + g_part * C[j][k]) % P

print(g2[n][m])
